taskMapping.ocr-with-region: Same all-visible-printed-text task for both providers; evaluate only the pre-annotated digit subset against numeral GT.
taskMapping.component-location: Preserve labels/locations/native outputs; no new component GT or accuracy score.

matching.coordinateConversion: Provider-declared source image coordinate system to original image; quad_1000 divided by1000 then width/height, preserving quadrilateral. No inferred boxes, clamping or frame correction.
matching.sourceCorrespondence: Unique spatial containment of frozen target center in source quadrilateral; ambiguous many-to-one/one-to-many stays ambiguous. No closest-value/label matching.
matching.values: Compare a uniquely localized observed numeral to the existing GT literal/number. Preserve raw string. Conservative whitespace-only normalization; multi-token/invalid/unreadable stays unknown or ambiguous, not0.
matching.unmatchedPolicy: Raw OCR covers unannotated text/card/legend numerals too. Unmatched is NOT automatically a physical false positive. Offline source/scope adjudication required; retain unannotated legitimate, localization miss, ambiguous, or confirmed hallucination separately.
matching.scopeLimit: Do not force inventory counts, silently split one OCR box into multiple locations, repair6/9 from game balance, or treat saved/native corrected state as raw model accuracy.

isolation: Never pass this sidecar, GT paths/values/target counts, previous predictions/errors, or confirmed evaluation frame to provider request construction.
